Kho]] |blank1_name = Political party |blank1_info = {{Color box|{{party color|Lakas-CMD}}|border=darkgray}} [[Lakas–CMD]] |blank2_name = Congressional bloc |blank2_info = Majority }} '''Masbate's 3rd congressional district''' is one of the three [[congressional districts of the Philippines]] in the province of [[Masbate]]. It has been represented in the [[House of Representatives of the Philippines|House of Representatives]] since 1987.{{cite web|url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/legislators/?v=province |title=Roster of Philippine legislators |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=February 15, 2021}} The district encompasses the eastern half of [[Masbate Island]] consisting of the municipalities of [[Cataingan]], [[Cawayan, Masbate|Cawayan]], [[Dimasalang]], [[Esperanza, Masbate|Esperanza]], [[Palanas, Masbate|Palanas]], [[Pio V. Corpuz, Masbate|Pio V. Corpuz]], [[Placer, Masbate|Placer]] and [[Uson, Masbate|Uson]].{{cite web|url=https://www.chanrobles.com/ordinance.htm |title=The 1987 Constitution of the Republic of the Philippines |publisher=Chan Robles Virtual Law Library |accessdate=February 15, 2021}} It is currently represented in the [[20th Congress of the Philippines|20th Congress]] by [[Wilton Kho|Wilton T.
